original_publisher: Naperville Police Department, City of Naperville, Illinois

changes.title: Audit cadence
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.3(A)(5) required an annual ALPR audit covering password security, usage and training.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.11(A) requires documented monthly audits, while paragraph (E) separately preserves annual comprehensive audits.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: Changed from annual-only auditing to documented monthly checks plus an annual comprehensive audit.
changes.next_independent_verification: Confirm completion of monthly reviews and annual program audit from de-identified administrative records.

changes.title: Audit criteria
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.3(A)(5) described password, usage and training as broad audit areas.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.11(B)-(D) calls for sampling individual searches, justifications, external dissemination, emergency searches and anomalous activity.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: The 2026 text spells out materially more detailed review criteria and targeted scrutiny than the 2025 version.
changes.next_independent_verification: Obtain aggregate completed monthly audit checklists and disposition of escalated anomalies, without individual vehicle searches.

changes.title: Ongoing external network access
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.2(E) generally permitted dissemination to law enforcement agencies for an authorized purpose.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.2(J) specifically conditions persistent regional, statewide, nationwide or vendor network access on leadership approval and periodic review or revocation.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: Ongoing agency network relationships receive an express approval and revocation condition absent from the earlier clause.
changes.next_independent_verification: Check dated network-sharing permissions, documented periodic reviews and executed interagency terms.

changes.title: Historical search justification fields
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.7(B)-(C) required a related valid incident number for local and nationwide searches.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.7(D) requires a valid incident/CAD/case identifier, incident type, written purpose and reasonably necessary search criteria and scope.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: The later revision enumerates additional mandatory documentation fields for historical queries.
changes.next_independent_verification: Review redacted configuration screenshots or aggregate compliance audit findings, not individual plate histories.

changes.title: Exigent search exception and follow-up
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.7(B)-(C) required a valid related incident number for searches, without describing an emergency exception there.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.7(E) permits a documented emergency search before an identifier exists, requires later case linkage and monthly audit review.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: The new text adds an explicit emergency workflow with retrospective identification and audit requirements.
changes.next_independent_verification: Determine how emergency searches are identified in aggregate monthly reviews and whether documentation was completed.

changes.title: Advanced search scope/duration
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.7(B)-(C) described plate information or a vehicle description as search inputs.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.7(C) permits vehicle-characteristic and travel-pattern features only when their scope and duration fit the documented purpose, excluding generalized surveillance.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: The later clause adds express limits for advanced analytical criteria not specified in the former historical-search provisions.
changes.next_independent_verification: Obtain policy-linked system configuration documentation and administrator training, excluding raw vehicle observations.

changes.title: Manual hot-list entry requirements
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.5(F) allowed manually entered plates and required a reason in the software notes field.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.8(C) specifies incident/CAD/case, purpose, creator identity, entry date and a review/expiration date when available.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: The new version formalizes multiple mandatory traceability fields beyond a simple reason note.
changes.next_independent_verification: Verify form requirements and aggregate incomplete-entry audit rates under the revised policy.

changes.title: Manual hot-list expiration
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.5(F) described manual entries and reason notes but set no explicit routine expiration in that provision.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.8(E)-(F) generally expires manual alerts after 30 days unless a reviewer renews a documented continuing need.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: A default 30-day manual-alert expiry and reasoned renewal appears in the revised provisions.
changes.next_independent_verification: Check generic system expiration settings and aggregate overdue review exceptions.

changes.title: Removal once alert basis ends
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.5(F) discussed the creation and documentation of manually entered alerts, without a specific removal-trigger clause.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.8(G) directs removal when the basis ends, including recovered vehicles, resolved missing-person alerts or inaccurate inputs.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: The revised policy expressly defines trigger conditions for removal of stale or invalid manual alerts.
changes.next_independent_verification: Examine aggregate closure and revocation audit procedures rather than requesting any individual watchlist content.

changes.title: Training curriculum
changes.before_summary: Section 41.16.9 required initial equipment and LEADS training and updates for hardware, software and law changes.
changes.after_summary: Section 41.16.10 additionally requires instruction about prohibited uses, constitutional protections, query documentation, retention and independent alert verification.
changes.substantive_wording_difference: The later curriculum is materially broader and expressly covers privacy and accountability controls.
changes.next_independent_verification: Request the curriculum outline and dates of completion for the updated training without personally identifying trainee records.

limitations: Two dated, original-government PDF versions explicitly linked by the municipality, with exact original PDF page anchors. Ten distinct text-clause comparisons are not ten independently verified agency decisions; no separate human editor has signed off. No case-level data, current operations, vendor wrongdoing or legal violation is inferred.
